Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question at the outset, reframing it as a search for a film “between The Bears and I and Oceans” in release order instead of recognizing that the query simply asks which film was released on July 31, 1974 by Buena Vista Distribution (i.e., The Bears and I). This misframing drove subsequent steps toward finding an irrelevant “intermediate” title (e.g., The Island at the Top of the World) rather than concluding with the correct, already-documented answer.
